data.title: bn-30fs static receipt and Cargo namespace review
data.description: Risk-high independent static review of exact commit f0ac22ef8d2268a372724a5e3d2f4083d22395b7 tree 8156e2bcb703e40bf050f43d07ccca4c6f271301. Scope: wrapper receipt producer/consumer exactness; exact eight-entry Cargo config namespace replay per build; bind semantics; TOCTOU/fail-closed behavior; hostile-validator adequacy. No Cargo/rustc/product/build/child/network/security tooling.

data.body: [HIGH] Preserved non-config CARGO_HOME directories remain live, unreviewed build inputs.  retains a top-level directory FD for entries such as , and  then s that whole directory into the private Cargo home, but neither  nor  recursively snapshots or hashes its contents. The latter only compares device/type/inode/permissions for the selected directory; the final toolchain/input checks do not cover CARGO_HOME. Offline Cargo reads registry index/cache/source content from this tree, so a same-user change to a nested crate source or index entry during a build (including swap-and-restore) can change compiled bytes while every recorded config replay and retained-directory check passes. Guest read-only mounting does not stop host-side mutation of the same directory object. Freeze the complete build-reachable Cargo home (prefer an immutable private exact-byte tree whose manifest is authority-bound) or retain and verify every reachable entry across each build; add a hostile nested-registry mutation/restoration probe. This is broader than config-search naming but is a real input-authority/TOCTOU gap in the bind design.

[clarification with exact identifiers] `_capture_directory` retains top-level directory FDs such as `registry`; `prepare_bwrap_args` uses `--ro-bind-fd` for them. Neither `CargoConfigSearchGuard.replay` nor `BoundBuildDirectory.verify` recursively snapshots or hashes those directory contents.

Static temp-tree reproduction: after entering `CargoConfigSearchGuard`, I changed `cargo-home/registry/crate-input` bytes from `reviewed` to `hostile!`, called `guard.replay`, restored the bytes, and exited normally. Both `baseline_equals_during` and `baseline_equals_restored` were true; no guard or exit verification rejected the mutation. No Cargo/rustc/child was run.

data.reason: BLOCK exact f0ac22ef8d2268a372724a5e3d2f4083d22395b7: one reproducible HIGH input-authority gap. Exact config files and the eight guest search positions are frozen correctly, but non-config CARGO_HOME directories are live directory binds with no recursive manifest or retained-entry replay, so offline registry inputs can mutate during a build undetected. Receipt producer/consumer exact targeting, single-use creation, mode/hash/size checks, descriptor binds, and boundary config replay otherwise pass this static slice.
